verdict.rationale: incident.io documents its own API reference covering endpoints, authentication, rate limits and errors, with examples. It also offers a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec, which supports exploring the API. The evidence never shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in the browser, so only the static-reference half of the story is evidenced. The probe 404s on guessed OpenAPI paths do not contradict the documented spec download. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable/executable examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: This is the API reference for incident.io. It documents available API endpoints, provides examples of how to use them, and covers authentication, rate limits, and error handling.
